name: Kamiya Rin
source:
The main heroine who recently transferred to Ryuusei Academy, and is a classmate of Akito. 

Has a bit of a shadowy atmosphere, and she's one who doesn't speak unless spoken to. Beautiful and has a nice figure. Has good grades, and the number of boys secretly aiming to date her is rapidly increasing. The girls are also fond of her. 

Behind the face she puts on everyday, she's actually a demon hunter who hunts Youmas ever since she was a child. She's an elite demon hunter who uses the power of the wolf, and so she has its high offensive power, explosive speed, and most of all, the ability to materialize a sword out of the fang of her spirit wolf. 

Using her sword and ablities, she mercilessly eliminates Youmas without hesitation as an elite demon hunter. She's also known as the "wolf of the silver blade", and is feared even by Youmas. 

[Slightly edited and translated from [url=http://www.lilith-soft.com/lilith/product44/04chara_1.html]Official Site[/url]]
